heading: EXT. MOONDUST TACOS FOOD TRUCK - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. MOONDUST TACOS FOOD TRUCK - NIGHT
A silver food truck sits on a gravel lot under three moons.

Steam curls from the grill, and a tiny robot named ZIP wobbles along the counter on caster wheels, juggling a lime, a squeeze bottle and a napkin while LUCY the cook flips tortillas without looking and BIG MO, her towering brother, lifts a crate of glowing peppers over a sleepy dog that snores by the generator.
Two teenagers in shiny silver jackets lean on the window and argue about which moon is the best moon.
Okay team, last orders, then we blast off for the next planet!
units.name: LUCY

units.text: Lime, lime, where is the lime... oh. I am holding the lime.
units.name: ZIP

units.text: Boss, the engine is making that noise again. The sad one.
units.name: BIG MO

units.text: Then sing it a happy song.
units.name: LUCY

units.text: A phone buzzes on the counter.
Lucy taps it, and a hologram of GRANDMA TESS flickers above the grill.
Lucy, sweetheart, are you eating? You sound thin.
units.name: GRANDMA TESS

units.text: I can hear everything. Tell Mo to stop lifting with his back.
units.name: GRANDMA TESS

units.text: The dog opens one eye, sighs, and goes back to sleep.
